title.en: Find the BPDUs in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and show only spanning tree messages.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur sirf spanning tree messages dikhao.

expect.en: Configuration BPDUs to 01:80:c2:00:00:00 showing the Root Bridge ID, Root Path Cost and the sender's Bridge ID and Port ID, roughly every 2 seconds.
expect.hinglish: 01:80:c2:00:00:00 ko Configuration BPDUs, jinme Root Bridge ID, Root Path Cost aur sender ki Bridge ID aur Port ID dikhti hai, lagbhag har 2 seconds mein.

why.en: In the link-fail scenario, TCN BPDUs and the TC flag announce the change.
why.hinglish: Link-fail scenario mein TCN BPDUs aur TC flag change announce karte hain.

expect.en: A 4-byte TCN BPDU going up the tree, then hellos with the Topology Change flag set for about 35 seconds.
expect.hinglish: Tree mein upar jati ek 4-byte TCN BPDU, phir lagbhag 35 seconds tak Topology Change flag set wale hellos.

title.hinglish: Broadcast storm ko repeat hote dekho

why.en: In the storm scenario, the same ARP broadcast keeps reappearing because Ethernet has no TTL.
why.hinglish: Storm scenario mein wahi ARP broadcast baar-baar dikhta hai kyunki Ethernet mein TTL nahi hota.

expect.en: Many identical ARP requests in a short time, the signature of a loop.
expect.hinglish: Thode se time mein bahut saari identical ARP requests, jo loop ki pehchan hai.

title.en: Look up the MAC table of your own PC's neighbours
title.hinglish: Apne PC ke padosiyon ki MAC table dekho

why.en: Read-only view of the ARP cache; after a topology change a real switch also relearns these MACs on new ports.
why.hinglish: ARP cache ka read-only view; topology change ke baad asli switch bhi yeh MACs naye ports par dobara seekhta hai.

expect.en: A list of IP addresses with their MAC addresses on your local network. Contents vary by machine.
expect.hinglish: Tumhare local network ke IP addresses aur unke MAC addresses ki list. Contents machine ke hisaab se alag hote hain.
